description: The Mayhem app's overlay over the League game (overlay.rs): a transparent window over the game's client area that lets every click through and never takes the focus. Its page only hears what to draw (overlay-cards: per offered augment a tier letter and up to two item numbers, the build's name, where each card's name is), asks once what to draw now (mayhem_overlay_now) and writes its errors to the error log (errors.rs). Rust alone shows, places and hides it. Nothing else; no window, filesystem, shell or HTTP permissions.
